seo.title: Residential
seo.description: Our residential architecture places an emphasis on creating beautiful, functional and efficient homes, to address the unique needs of each site and client.

value.left: ### We enjoy designing bespoke, light filled and spatially efficient private homes.
value.right: {% regular %}Nowhere matters more than home. At Architecture Matters, we undertake a limited number of residential extension and new build projects each year, providing an end-to-end brief development, design and project management service to clients who seek both a great design outcome and an experienced guide for their home building project.{% /regular %}
